stem: Which of the following should replace sentence 4 to effectively state the controlling idea of this paper?

options.label: A
options.text: There are professionals known as Foley artists, and they got their name from Jack Foley, who was the first Foley artist.

options.label: B
options.text: Many of the sound effects that movie audiences hear are made by Foley artists, film industry professionals whose work is done after the filming of a movie is complete.

options.label: C
options.text: The sounds that you and I hear when we go to see a movie were not always made when the movie was being recorded.

options.label: D
options.text: Professionals create the things that are in the background in movies, including galloping horses, pelting rain, and chirping crickets.
